description:
- **Parent update:** Updated to HushGram 0.0.22 for Instagram 456.0.0.53.78.
- **Scoped search:** Optionally search only the current settings section and its nested pages. Settings home still searches everything.
- **Settings appearance:** Instagram-style rows now use Material colors, with a cleaner restart indicator on toggles.
- **Chat accents:** Improved inbox and Activity row backgrounds, chat input surfaces, and pinned-message contrast.
- **Message blur:** Updated held-message blur for Compose chats while preserving the selected message area.
- **Reaction placement:** Aligned reactions with held-message bounds and removed the extra message-menu edge gap.
- **Inbox controls:** Preserved independent Settings and Compose buttons and native inbox hold-menu behavior.
- **Organization:** Placed new parent settings in related sections.
- **Regression checks:** Expanded focused native-hook and UI coverage.
- **Downloads:** Includes the MPP bundle, dependency SBOM, build identity, and SHA-256 checksums.
- **Installation:** Use stock Instagram 456.0.0.53.78 and refresh the InstaPrime source in Morphe Manager.
- **Credits:** Core patches and upstream maintenance by [SysAdminDoc and HushGram contributors](https://github.com/SysAdminDoc/HushGram). [Support the original creator](https://ko-fi.com/X8K126YVER).
